edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the token holder whose balance is debited in transfer
msg.sender is used as spender when deducting allowance in transferFrom
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve
msg.sender is the depositor whose aToken balance and reserve state are updated
msg.sender is the borrower whose collateral is validated before borrowing
msg.sender must equal _onBehalfOf when repaying the full amount
flashLoan is public and moves pool liquidity to an arbitrary receiver
any account may trigger liquidationCall on an undercollateralized user
redirectInterestStream uses msg.sender as the interest source
redirectInterestStreamInternal moves the balances of msg.sender
onlyLendingPool modifier requires lendingPoolAddress == msg.sender
onlyOverlyingAToken modifier requires msg.sender == aToken address
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against the stored _owner
initialize is externally callable and only guarded by an implementation slot check
compounded interest is computed from block.timestamp minus lastUpdateTimestamp
getCompoundedBorrowBalance derives interest from block.timestamp
calculateUserGlobalData returns balances that depend on block.timestamp
borrow writes block.timestamp into the user lastUpdateTimestamp
repay uses a timestamp driven compounded borrow balance
transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable
renounceOwnership clears the _owner state variable
_balances mapping is read and written by transfer
_allowances mapping is decremented in transferFrom
component address is read from the AddressStorage registry
updateImplInternal reads and writes the address registry
reserve data is read to validate liquidity before borrowing
user reserve data is updated by the borrow flow
reserve data is aggregated to compute global account data
user reserve data is aggregated to compute global account data
redeem uses underlyingAssetAddress when calling the pool
interestRedirectionAddresses is updated during redirection
redirectedBalances is updated during redirection
userIndexes is updated while cumulating balance on transfer
guard counter is copied into the local counter
Proxy._delegate performs delegatecall into the implementation
liquidationCall delegatecalls the liquidation manager with user supplied arguments
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls into the new implementation
transferToUser forwards ETH with a low level call
liquidateFee sends ETH to the destination via a low level call

ERC20._transfer relies on SafeMath add and sub for balance updates
calculateCompoundedInterest uses rayPow and rayMul arithmetic
getCompoundedBorrowBalance performs ray multiplication and division

deposit mints aTokens through mintOnDeposit
AToken.redeem calls pool.redeemUnderlying

flashLoan moves funds to the receiver through core.transferToUser

repay forwards the origination fee to the fee collection address
repay returns the principal to the reserve
_to recipient parameter is used by transfer
_amount parameter sets the borrow size
_reserve parameter selects the deposit target
_receiver parameter selects the flashloan receiver
_user parameter selects the account being aggregated
_onBehalfOf parameter selects the repayment target
newImplementation parameter is the upgraded implementation address
_spender parameter is the approved spender

BorrowLocalVars buffers the borrow computation
amountToRedeem is computed inside AToken.redeem
balanceDecreaseAllowedLocalVars buffers the balance decrease check

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only the destination argument of the ERC20 transfer entrypoint
_amount is only the borrowed size argument of the borrow entrypoint
_reserve is only the reserve selector argument of the deposit entrypoint
_receiver is only the receiver address argument of the flashLoan entrypoint
_user is only the subject account argument of the global data aggregation
_onBehalfOf is only the repayment target argument of the repay entrypoint
newImplementation is only the implementation argument of the upgrade entrypoint
_spender is only the allowance recipient argument of approve
localCounter only exists inside the nonReentrant modifier guarding deposit-like entrypoints
the c local only holds the SafeMath result used by the internal transfer balance updates
BorrowLocalVars only buffers intermediate values inside borrow
amountToRedeem is only computed and consumed inside AToken.redeem
balanceDecreaseAllowedLocalVars only buffers values inside balanceDecreaseAllowed
